format: Edited actual application captures and labeled saved-evidence cards with local narration; not an uninterrupted live recording

scenes.title: Start with your own CSV.
scenes.narration: Bring your own C S V. Preview your inputs and exchange rates, then create linked revenue reports. This C S V example has two rows.

scenes.title: Separate guided demo: changed revenue is withheld.
scenes.narration: In the separate guided demo, correct the euro exchange rate. Revenue becomes stale and is withheld. The independent support count stays current, while previous revenue remains clearly historical.
scenes.footer: Edited app capture · Separate guided demo · Authored fixture

scenes.title: Native HydraDB queries explain the affected work.
scenes.narration: Hydra D B traces the inputs each tool actually consumed, linking this calculation to both reports.

scenes.title: Four tools refresh both dependent reports.
scenes.narration: Four tools refresh the dependent work. Company revenue becomes five thousand seven hundred fifty-five dollars; E U revenue, two thousand two hundred eighty. Independent recomputation matches.
scenes.footer: Edited app capture · Authored browser fixture

scenes.title: Saved-report refresh: a separate model experiment.
scenes.narration: After a correction, an analyst needs to know which reports can still be used. We tested that on eight retail cases, with forty-eight Fable five point two runs. The model proposes a plan; the same tools handle every refresh.
scenes.footer: Saved execution evidence · Local experiment · See accompanying results for full scope

scenes.title: Three methods refreshed every recoverable report.
scenes.narration: Graph, exact traversal, and full context refreshed all thirty-two recoverable reports. Every method blocked all four unavailable reports. No incorrect report was marked current.
scenes.footer: Saved execution evidence · Local experiment · See accompanying results for full scope

scenes.title: 60.67% fewer provider input tokens than full context.
scenes.narration: Graph used sixty point six seven percent fewer input tokens than full context, excluding the no-op. Graph and exact traversal gave the model identical prompts.
scenes.footer: Saved execution evidence · Local experiment · See accompanying results for full scope

scenes.title: Limits of this result and the earlier deterministic test.
scenes.narration: The model test used one sample per case and method, with adaptive allowances. An earlier deterministic test fell short at a fixed cap and failed its development gate.
scenes.footer: Saved execution evidence · Local experiment · See accompanying results for full scope

scenes.title: A real client uses ProofFlow through five MCP tools.
scenes.narration: An actual Claude client uses five M C P tools to load data, choose plans, inspect and refresh. It reuses prior artifacts on authored two-row input. After a launch-configuration fix, one trajectory passed thirty-two checks, with nine requests and twelve recorded runtime calls. Its first configuration failure is retained.
scenes.footer: Saved execution evidence · Recorded local results · Full scope in the accompanying report
